learning_path:
**Learning Path for a Confident Public Speaker and Presenter**
====================================================================

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU5835 | Professional Selling: Step 2 - Prepare Like a High-Performer | Coursera | Develop foundational communication skills, including establishing needs and problems, strategizing, and tracking conversion ratios. |
| 2 | COU2728 | Market Research Specialization | Coursera | Build on existing communication skills by learning to analyze and interpret data, develop a research proposal, and manage research instruments. |
| 3 | COU4016 | Microsoft 365 Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Apply market research skills by learning to create and edit workbooks, manage presentations, and describe Microsoft 365 apps and services. |
| 4 | COU1950 | Programming Fundamentals in Kotlin | Coursera | Develop programming skills to create and manage presentations, and apply them to real-life situations. |
| 5 | COU5780 | Microsoft Azure Data Engineering Associate (DP-203) Professional Certificate | Coursera | Learn to develop Azure compute solutions, monitor and troubleshoot Azure solutions, and develop for Azure storage. |
| 6 | COU1612 | Mastering Geospatial Analysis with QGIS | Coursera | Apply data engineering skills by learning to deploy web and mobile GIS applications, skills in satellite data acquisition, classification, and temporal analysis. |
| 7 | COU5758 | Rapid Prototyping Materials and Tooling | Coursera | Develop skills in rapid prototyping, including knowledge of materials and tools used for rapid prototyping. |
| 8 | COU215 | Social Policy for Social Services & Health Practitioners Specialization | Coursera | Apply rapid prototyping skills by learning to differentiate alternative approaches to social policy problems, critique components of a social policy, and apply concepts and tools to advance energy justice. |
| 9 | COU2969 | Social Services for Families, Seniors and Those with Disabilities | Coursera | Learn to design and redesign energy systems to put justice at the center, recognizing energy injustice, and applying concepts and tools to advance energy justice. |
| 10 | COU6487 | Healthcare Organizations and the Health System | Coursera | Apply social services skills by learning to design and redesign energy systems to put justice at the center, recognizing energy injustice, and applying concepts and tools to advance energy justice. |

The learning path starts with developing foundational communication skills, including establishing needs and problems, strategizing, and tracking conversion ratios. It then builds on these skills by learning to analyze and interpret data, develop a research proposal, and manage research instruments. The path continues by applying market research skills to create and edit workbooks, manage presentations, and describe Microsoft 365 apps and services. Next, it develops programming skills to create and manage presentations, and applies them to real-life situations. The path then learns to develop Azure compute solutions, monitor and troubleshoot Azure solutions, and develop for Azure storage. It applies data engineering skills by learning to deploy web and mobile GIS applications, skills in satellite data acquisition, classification, and temporal analysis. The path continues by developing skills in rapid prototyping, including knowledge of materials and tools used for rapid prototyping. It applies rapid prototyping skills by learning to differentiate alternative approaches to social policy problems, critique components of a social policy, and apply concepts and tools to advance energy justice. Finally, it learns to design and redesign energy systems to put justice at the center, recognizing energy injustice, and applying concepts and tools to advance energy justice.

This learning path provides a comprehensive foundation in sustainability, environmental policy, and corporate responsibility, progressing from foundational to advanced courses. The path begins with EDX1173, introducing sustainability concepts and environmental policy frameworks. EDX3225 and EDX3340 build on this knowledge, developing skills in business sustainability management and corporate sustainability management. EDX3254 and EDX3418 focus on sustainability leadership and high-impact leadership, respectively. EDX3299 introduces technology and management aspects of sustainability strategy, while EDX2078 develops skills in corporate sustainability, social innovation, and ethics. The path continues with EDX3436, focusing on sustainable fashion and brand strategy, and EDX875, emphasizing responsible innovation and stakeholder engagement. EDX3435 and EDX2960 develop skills in compliance management and data storytelling, respectively.
